mechanism: Both evaluators initialize history with prompt IDs, apply one sign-sensitive penalty per distinct token ID over the full history at window0, and append generated tokens. Thus citations, quantities and terms appearing in source passages are penalized along with previous answer tokens.1.0 makes this operation a no-op. Whether removing it improves full answers remains unproven.
